name: PoleAttachmentApplicationManager
tagline: Every pole attachment application, every deadline clock, every late pole owner – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete attacher-side permit pipeline for fibre and wireless builders: applications per pole owner, survey / estimate / acceptance / make-ready deadline clocks with large-order rules, self-help eligibility, one-touch make-ready, estimate approvals, permit expiry, fees and pole-owner on-time scorecards. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Deadline clock per stage with large-order extensions
Self-help eligibility and recorded self-help notices
OTMR rules and estimate approval limit
Rejected poles, fees due vs paid, permit expiry
Bulk submit, fees paid, coordinator assignment, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with fictional sample data
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA
